title: Fin Box Interior — General Visual Inspection and Web Thickness Reference Check

issue.reason: Original issue of the fin box interior general visual inspection and web thickness reference check.

abstract: General visual inspection inside the fin box between ribs 1 and 9, including the web thickness reference check that confirms the ribs are within the thinning allowance.

sections.purpose: This task gives the general visual inspection of the fin box interior between ribs 1 and 9, together with the web thickness reference check that confirms no rib web has thinned below the allowance.
sections.job_setup_note: Access is through the fin leading edge panels and needs a working platform at fin height. The interior must be dry and lit to at least 500 lux at the inspection surface. A person working inside the fin box must be attached to the fall arrest point and a second person must remain at the access opening for the whole time.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE FIN BOX WITHOUT A SECOND PERSON AT THE ACCESS OPENING AND WITHOUT THE FALL ARREST HARNESS ATTACHED. 2. Position the working platform and remove the fin leading edge access panels. 3. Ventilate the fin box interior for at least ten minutes before entry. 4. Do a general visual inspection of the rib D5530116876335 at each position between rib 1 and rib 9. 5. Examine the shear tie D5530114423837 at every rib foot for cracking, for movement of the protective treatment and for loose fasteners. 6. CAUTION: DO NOT STAND ON A RIB WEB. A FOOT LOAD ON AN UNSUPPORTED WEB WILL DEFORM IT. 7. Measure the web thickness at the reference position marked on each rib and compare it with the reference value of 4.0 mm; a value below 3.4 mm is a rejectable condition. 8. Examine the screws AES932279K1 at the rib feet for the correct installation and for corrosion. 9. Examine the fin box drain positions and confirm that they are clear. 10. Install the access panels and remove the working platform.
sections.close_out: Make sure that no tool, no light and no loose object stays inside the fin box; do the tool count at the access opening before the panels are installed. Install the fin leading edge access panels. Record the inspection result and the measured web thickness values in the aircraft technical record.

safety_precautions: Do not enter the fin box without a second person at the access opening.
Attach the fall arrest harness to the designated point.
Ventilate the fin box interior before entry.

title: Fin Box Interior — General Visual Inspection and Web Thickness Reference Check

issue.reason: Web thickness reference table split by rib standard and the measurement points defined relative to the pocket boundary.

abstract: General visual inspection inside the fin box between ribs 1 and 9, including the web thickness reference check, which is read against the rib standard installed and is taken on the land beside the pocket on a pocketed rib.

sections.purpose: This task gives the general visual inspection of the fin box interior between ribs 1 and 9, together with the web thickness reference check, which is read against the rib standard installed and not against a single figure.
sections.job_setup_note: Access is through the fin leading edge panels and needs a working platform at fin height. The interior must be dry and lit to at least 500 lux at the inspection surface. A person working inside the fin box must be attached to the fall arrest point and a second person must remain at the access opening for the whole time.
sections.procedure: 1. WARNING: DO NOT ENTER THE FIN BOX WITHOUT A SECOND PERSON AT THE ACCESS OPENING AND WITHOUT THE FALL ARREST HARNESS ATTACHED. 2. Position the working platform and remove the fin leading edge access panels. 3. Ventilate the fin box interior for at least ten minutes before entry. 4. Do a general visual inspection of the rib D5530116876335 at each position between rib 1 and rib 9. 5. Examine the shear tie D5530114423837 at every rib foot for cracking, for movement of the protective treatment and for loose fasteners. 6. CAUTION: DO NOT STAND ON A RIB WEB. THE POCKETED WEB IS 2.6 MM THICK AND WILL DEFORM UNDER A FOOT LOAD. 7. Identify the rib standard from the etched mark at the rib foot before any measurement is taken; the solid rib is marked S and the pocketed rib P. 8. Measure the web thickness on a solid rib at the reference position marked on the web and compare it with the solid column of the reference table. 9. On a pocketed rib, take the measurement on the land between the pockets, 20 mm outboard of the pocket boundary at the marked position, and compare it with the pocketed column. A measurement taken inside a pocket reads about 1.4 mm thinner than the land and is not a finding; it means the gauge was put in the wrong place. 10. Confirm that the recorded values are consistent across ribs 4 to 9; a mixed set is a rejectable condition. 11. Examine the screws AES932279K1 at the rib feet for the correct installation and for corrosion. 12. Examine the fin box drain positions and confirm that they are clear. 13. Install the access panels and remove the working platform.
sections.close_out: Make sure that no tool, no light and no loose object stays inside the fin box; do the tool count at the access opening before the panels are installed. Install the fin leading edge access panels. Record the inspection result and the measured web thickness values in the aircraft technical record.

type_data.effectivity_note: All aircraft. The reference table has a solid column and a pocketed column; the rib standard is read from the etched mark at the rib foot and decides which column and which measurement point apply.

safety_precautions: Do not enter the fin box without a second person at the access opening.
Attach the fall arrest harness to the designated point.
Ventilate the fin box interior before entry.
